R01-FORGED-HUMAN-GATE-RESUME.precondition: Caller can construct a mapping that contains gate_id, workflow_id, correlation_id, and task_id.
R01-FORGED-HUMAN-GATE-RESUME.reproduction: Pass a mapping with arbitrary identities and no approval evidence, status, timestamp, gate binding, or decision record.
R01-FORGED-HUMAN-GATE-RESUME.expected: Fail closed unless a persisted approved decision is bound to the current gate, run, task, and unrevoked approval identity.
R01-FORGED-HUMAN-GATE-RESUME.actual: Returns status RESUMED and echoes the forged identities.
R01-FORGED-HUMAN-GATE-RESUME.security_or_reliability_effect: A forged or stale payload can bypass the human-gate boundary.
R01-FORGED-HUMAN-GATE-RESUME.minimal_test: Reject forged, missing, wrong-gate, wrong-task, stale, replayed, revoked, and malformed approvals; accept only the matching persisted approval.
R01-FORGED-HUMAN-GATE-RESUME.suggested_fix_boundary: Validate through the Mac-owned canonical decision store; do not trust a caller-supplied dictionary.

R02-CONCURRENT-REVIEW-LEDGER.precondition: Two processes share one review ledger and synchronize immediately before record_review.
R02-CONCURRENT-REVIEW-LEDGER.reproduction: Two forked workers both record the same diff_hash with distinct review IDs. Both calls return their own accepted entry; only one remains in ledger.json.
R02-CONCURRENT-REVIEW-LEDGER.expected: Exactly one semantic review or an explicit deterministic conflict.
R02-CONCURRENT-REVIEW-LEDGER.actual: Two callers report acceptance, while one durable record is lost by last-writer-wins replacement.
R02-CONCURRENT-REVIEW-LEDGER.security_or_reliability_effect: Duplicate review execution and lost review history can occur across processes.
R02-CONCURRENT-REVIEW-LEDGER.minimal_test: Use two process barriers; assert one accepted record and one conflict/reuse result, with a durable ledger and log that agree.
R02-CONCURRENT-REVIEW-LEDGER.suggested_fix_boundary: Use a cross-platform transaction lock or canonical authority around load, dedupe, append, and replace.
